defs.def: physical harm caused to sth which makes it less attractive, useful or valuable （有形的）损坏，破坏，损失

ex.s: The damage to the scentscape could result in harm to both health and spiritual practice.
ex.t: 气味景观的破坏可能对健康和精神修行都造成伤害。

ex.s: Damages of scentscapes can be artificially repaired.
ex.t: 缺失植物的气味在大气中被保存下来。

ex.s: Its roadway was damaged by vehicles
ex.t: 它的通道被许多人堵塞。

ex.s: If your student ID card no longer works or has been damaged, or if you have changed your personal or programme details, you should call into the Student Administration Centre （SAC） to request a new one.
ex.t: 如果你的学生证失效或损坏，或者你更改了个人或课程信息，你应到学生事务中心（SAC）申请补办。

ex.s: They damage the instruments.
ex.t: 它们会损坏仪器。

ex.s: aim at victims precisely     B. damage databases easily
ex.t: 精确瞄准受害者 B. 容易破坏数据库

ex.s: Fire extinguishers are located on each floor and in each apartment． Use a fire extinguisher only if you have been trained to do so． Irresponsible use of a fire extinguisher can create a dangerous situation for other residents and could result in damage to personal property． Misuse of a fire extinguisher will result in fines．
ex.t: 每层楼和每个公寓都配有灭火器。只有在受过训练时才可使用。不负责任地使用灭火器会给其他住户带来危险，并可能损坏个人财产。滥用灭火器将被罚款。

ex.s: Damage to local ecology.
ex.t: 对当地生态的破坏。

ex.s: Floods have become more damaging in Bangladesh in recent decades.
ex.t: 近几十年来，孟加拉国的洪灾造成的破坏越来越严重。

ex.s: Without the glaciers, water will arrive in the rivers at times when it can damage crops.
ex.t: 如果没有冰川，水会在破坏农作物的时期流入河流。

ex.s: Without oxygen the brain is damaging quickly.
ex.t: 没有氧气，大脑会迅速受损。

ex.s: Lin Feng: In recent years, we have seen large areas of wetland that were damaged by human activity.
ex.t: 林峰：近年来，我们看到大片湿地被人类活动破坏。

ex.s: UNICEF was founded on 11 December 1946, to provide food and healthcare to children in countries damaging / damaged in World War Ⅱ.
ex.t: 联合国儿童基金会成立于1946年12月11日，旨在为二战中受损国家的儿童提供食物和医疗。

ex.s: Student A: Turn to Page 83 Student B: Turn to Page 86 HURRICANE KATRINA AUGUST 23-31, 2005 It is one of the costliest natural disasters in US history, causing USD 108 billion in damage.

defs.def: harmful effects on sb/sth 损害；伤害

ex.s: Irresponsible use of them can damage them．
ex.t: B．不负责任地使用它们会造成损害。

ex.s: The damage is usually more serious on the first plant, but the neighbors, relatively speaking, stay safer because they heard the alarm and knew what to do.
ex.t: 第一株植物受到的伤害通常更为严重，但相比之下，邻居们因为听到了警报而知道该怎么做，所以更加安全。

ex.s: Damage changes us before we are ready.
ex.t: 在我们准备好之前伤害就已经改变了我们。

ex.s: I have a very strong   51   that the lie we’re telling is doing   52   damage to our children.
ex.t: 我有一种非常强烈的___51___，我们所说的这个谎言正在对孩子们造成___52___伤害。

ex.s: Negative self-talk damages self-confidence and decreases self-respect.
ex.t: 消极的自我对话会损害自信并降低自尊。

ex.s: Not giving enough praise can be just as damaging gas giving too much.
ex.t: 不给予足够的赞扬可能和给予过多一样有害。

ex.s: In study after study,it appears that these chemical conversations help the neighbors .The damage is usually more serious on the first plant,but the neighbors ,relatively speaking ,stay safer because they heard the alarm and knew what to do.
ex.t: 在一项又一项的研究中，这些化学对话似乎帮助了邻近的植物。第一棵植物受到的损害通常更严重，但相对而言，邻近的植物更安全，因为它们听到了警报并知道该怎么做。

ex.s: Habitat loss, pesticide use, and climate change have caused dramatic declines in pollinator populations over the past couple of decades, which has damaged the US agricultural economy.
ex.t: 栖息地的丧失、杀虫剂的使用和气候变化在过去几十年中导致传粉昆虫数量急剧下降，这损害了美国农业经济。
